page: UpCloud GPU-96xCPU-960GB-4xB200 is a GPU-accelerated server configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 96 shared vCPUs and 960.0 GB of system memory, yielding 10.0 GB of RAM per core. The server is equipped with four NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs, providing a total of 768 GB of VRAM.

This configuration does not include local storage, meaning external storage volumes must be attached separately. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation for the 96 vCPUs, which may impact workloads requiring sustained, non-variable CPU performance.

Given the inclusion of four NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs and 960.0 GB of system memory, this server is designed for heavy GPU-accelerated workloads such as large language model training, complex data science jobs, and high-performance computing. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of GPUs and memory makes it a specialized option for parallel processing tasks where GPU performance is the primary bottleneck.
